fields.statement: Built ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path and ran it in a hermetic scratch repo with a run stopped at a wait step: leaf acceptance naming internal/nope.go, an unlinked Decision and a branch deleting the only file of a landed capability. With alpha lacking verifier Evidence, run code-check exited 1 with only the Evidence cause and listed 6 lint hits (path, test, script, unapplied-decision, removed-code-capability) in human output and --json; the journal entry carried them. After Evidence it exited 0 with passed true and the same hits; resuming the run, run status (human and --json) showed the hits under code_checks for every entry. --json and api call run.code-check gave identical bytes; dry-run lints were byte-stable across runs. Scoped TestScripts/(review-code-check|describe-golden) and internal/run, internal/api -run CodeCheck pass.

With the built binary, code-check on a scratch change set linted only its own nodes: a missing path, a missing Go test and a missing TestScripts/<name> each gave one hit; 'and/or', an https URL, internal/real.go:12, ./internal/... and backticked present paths gave none; a capability whose two paths are both gone was also reported unretired-capability. Rough edge: a backticked placeholder TestXxx in this change set's statement is linted as a missing test (finding recorded, minor). go test ./internal/modellint/... passes.

With the built binary: a Decision linked decided-by only from an uncommitted leaf (zeta) was reported; one linked from a leaf with a Leaf: commit (gamma) was not; an answers-only Decision was not; a Decision with no link was reported. go test ./internal/modellint/... passes.

With the built binary: a landed capability naming the directory olddir/, whose files the branch deleted, was reported removed-code-capability with ref olddir; a landed capability naming one deleted file and one still-present file was not reported; a landed capability naming legacy/old.txt deleted on the branch was reported. go test ./internal/modellint/... passes.

Built binary: workflow describe review shows code -> lints, lints pass -> review, fail -> lint-fix, lint-fix agent max_visits 1 pass -> review; workflow check review is valid. run lint-check exited 0 with no code-check entry yet, exit 2 usage with no RHIZA_RUN, and exit 1 listing all hits (human and --json) after a code-check with hits; as a workflow command step after code it failed the step. go test ./internal/workflow/... and ./internal/api -run LintCheck pass.

Built binary: rhiza guide fixer has the 'A lint-fix fixer' section naming rhiza run lint-check --json, the three fixes (rhiza set the text, retire the capability, link decided-by) and listing a wrongly judged hit as unfixed; the Checks: and never-push rules are still present. go test ./internal/guide/... passes.
